reader.requirement: At --std 85 an arithmetic expression or function inside a condition, and a negated condition, is evaluated only if and when the condition containing it is evaluated, in the order of figures 1-4 (AND, OR, OR-over-AND, and the parenthesized NOT shape).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.UnphrasedSizeErrorIsFatal: below 2002 a relation or sign condition whose operand performs arithmetic is wrapped in CobolSizeError.FalseWhenRaised(() => ...), a deferred lambda, so a size error makes the leaf false; at 2002+ it renders bare and a size error is fatal

reader.edition-search: grep -i 'edition|DialectLevel|Version' over ConditionRenderer.cs and ConditionBinder.cs. The binder's ctx.Edition uses are boolean-expression diagnostics (a 2002 construct). The renderer's other DialectLevel reads (lines 463, 475, 1167) choose an operand's comparison image, not the evaluation order. BoundLogical renders as C# && / || in operand order and BoundNot as !(...), at every edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes, outside this rule: an evaluated arithmetic leaf that raises a size error is false at 85 and fatal from 2002; WHEN it is evaluated is the same at both
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf15_02 covers functions and NOT in IF; an arithmetic expression that must not be evaluated, figure 4's (c1 OR NOT c2) AND c3 AND c4 with c3 false, and the other condition-taking statements are not exercised

probes.printed: C1 F / C2 T / C4 K=0 SEQ=5 / C7 F SEQ=5 / C9 F SEQ=5 / C11 SEQ=X (MATCH at --std 85 and --std 2023)
probes.expected: GR2: N / D with D = 0 behind a false AND or a true OR is never evaluated; NOT RANDOM(9) > 2 is skipped when c1 decides the inner level, and RANDOM(7) after the false F = 2 is skipped (figure 4)
the division is evaluated when the condition needs it

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.3.4 GR2  the text is in GR2 (quoted: "Values are established for arithmetic expressions and functions if and when the conditions containing them are evaluated")
OK  §1985:VI.6.3.4 GR2  the text is in GR2 (quoted: "negated conditions are evaluated if and when it is necessary")

reader.notes: Arithmetic and intrinsic-function operands are rendered inline inside the && / || chain, and the 85 size-error wrapper is a Func<bool>, so nothing is evaluated ahead of its condition. The UDF and OO drains in the seed sites (UdfAttachPerEvaluation, OoDrainPropertyGets) serve 2002 constructs, which --std 85 cannot reach.

refuter.evidence: cr1.cob A1/A2, aimed at the abbreviated combined relation, which §1985:VI.6.3.3 expands 'as if the last preceding stated subject were inserted': with seed 3 giving R1,R2,R3, 'IF FUNCTION RANDOM NOT < 0 AND < 1' consumes two RANDOM values (the next value is neither R2 nor R3, printed A1 OTHER: the subject is re-established for the second condition, not cached), and 'IF FUNCTION RANDOM > 1 AND < 2' consumes one (the next value is R3, printed under the label A2 TWICE, which I mislabeled: it means one call), so the implied second relation is not evaluated once the first is false. cr2.cob S1/S2: N / D with D=0 inside a sign condition is not evaluated behind a false AND or a true OR; S5 a function after a true OR leaf in PERFORM WITH TEST AFTER is never evaluated. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.3.4 GR2 ("if and when the conditions containing them are evaluated"); OK §1985:VI.6.3.3 (the quoted text lies in its SR2 paragraph).
